text:
Aisha Khan: quick thread — I drafted a short status update for the customers impacted by the onboarding delays this morning. want signoff before we go live. proposed send is a plain-status + invite to a 30min customer listening session and short feedback form. copy below.

Marco Li: sharing. plz include the current mitigation ETA (we have steady tailing errors but no new regressions). ETA for full backlog clear ~48h? confirming with infra. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya Desai: draft looks good. couple small edits: remove fraction mentions of internal rollback, change "we're investigating" -> "we completed an initial fix" for tone, and add a link to dedicated status page. also recommend we offer a 10% credit for next billing cycle for affected onboarding runs.

Aisha Khan: thanks — updated. please review the outbound text below and the listening session blurb. want to keep it customer-facing and short.

-- DRAFT OUTBOUND --
Hi {{customer_name}},

We're reaching out with an update on the onboarding delays you experienced earlier today. We completed an initial fix that stopped the failures and we've been processing the backlog; we expect normal throughput to resume within ~48 hours.

What we're doing now:
• Backfilling impacted jobs with priority routing.
• Adding an extra dedicated worker pool for onboarding bursts.
• Monitoring closely and will post real-time progress to https://status.redwood-inference.com

We want to hear from you: we're hosting a 30-minute listening session for affected customers on Thursday 3pm PT to walk through the impact, answer questions, and collect feedback. RSVP: https://forms.redwood-inference.com/onboard-listen

If this impacted a renewal or any critical go-live, reply to this email and we'll prioritize a one-on-one review with a solutions engineer. We're also issuing a 10% credit for the next month for affected onboarding runs.

Thanks for your patience —
Aisha on behalf of Redwood Customer Success
-- END DRAFT --

Devon Harper: 👍 love the listening session push. two asks: (1) can we make the RSVP form include a checkbox for "I need a 1:1 remediation", so CS can triage quickly? (2) add a line that links to our mitigation runbook for technical customers (short link ok).

Marta Reed: legal is fine with the language and the credit offer as long as CS flags accounts above $50k ARR for manual approvals. please compile a short list of impacted accounts over that threshold before sending.

Omar Velazquez: Customer Voice suggests a dedicated post-session survey that asks: how did this impact your onboarding timeline (days), did you lose revenue (yes/no), and willingness-to-recommend after remediation. we can capture structured feedback and feed it to product. I'll volunteer to run the session moderation.

Marco Li: infra update — we saw the root cause: a rare interaction between the onboarding queuer and a new caching policy that caused head-of-line blocking when multiple small batches arrived simultaneously. mitigation applied at 09:12; tail backlog processing started at 09:45 and is running at 1.8x baseline throughput with burst capacity. estimated clear 36-48h depending on customer queue depth. RCA doc: https://intra.redwood/rcas/onboard-caching-holb-4245 (internal)

SRE Bot: incident note recorded: INC-4245, severity 2, start 2024-11-06T08:54:00Z, mitigation applied 2024-11-06T09:12:00Z. link: https://incidents.redwood/4245

Aisha Khan: ok — next steps:
• Priya to finalize outbound copy with credit line and status page link (today EOD).
• Marco to confirm final ETA and a short technical blurb we can include for advanced users (ETA update by noon PST).
• Marta to review list of >$50k accounts (Marta will ack once list compiled).
• Omar + Devon to own RSVP form and session moderation + post-session survey.

Please reply with ack if you can do the above. i'll queue outbound after the >$50k list is confirmed so legal approvals are satisfied.

Priya Desai: ack — i'll push copy update and post here when done.

Marco Li: ack — will post final ETA by 11:50am PT.

Marta Reed: ack — i'll get the list by 12:30pm PT.

Omar Velazquez: ack — will share RSVP + survey link in this thread when ready.

Devon Harper: ack — can help triage one-on-ones after session.

Aisha Khan: thanks team. plan to publish to customers once we have Marta's list and Marco's final ETA. will update thread when outbound is sent. :email:
